children.text: An island home to Mactan-Cebu International Airport, just
20–40 minutes
from the airport to beach resorts. With hopping tours to Hilutungan and Nalusuan, diving, and a monument to the Battle of Mactan where Lapu-Lapu defeated Magellan in
, it's the hub of Cebu travel most visited by Korean family travelers.
Mactan Island is a flat coral island about
15km
long, connected to Cebu's main island to the east by three bridges. Mactan-Cebu International Airport is on the island itself, so
20–40 minutes

after landing you can be soaking in a beachfront resort pool. Administratively it's mostly Lapu-Lapu City, with the southern part belonging to the municipality of Cordova, and to Koreans, 'Cebu trip' is so familiar a phrase that it usually means exactly this Mactan Island resort vacation.
Mactan is also a symbolic place in Philippine history. On
April 27, 1521

, warriors led by the island's chieftain Lapu-Lapu fought the forces of Ferdinand Magellan, who was on his round-the-world voyage, and killed Magellan. Filipinos honor Lapu-Lapu as the first hero to stand against a foreign power, and at Mactan Shrine on the island's northeast side, a statue of Lapu-Lapu stands together with the Magellan Marker erected by Spain in
. In
, major events marked the battle's 500th anniversary.

The island's east coast is a resort belt lined with large resorts such as Shangri-La, Plantation Bay, Crimson, J Park, and Mövenpick. The beaches are not especially wide, but the sea in front of the resorts is calm and the coral reefs are close, making it a good place for snorkeling and diving. Small islands such as Hilutungan (also spelled Gilutungan), Nalusuan, and Cauhagan lie across the water east of Mactan, and a full day of island hopping by bangka is the signature Mactan itinerary.

For families with young children, filial trips with parents, or office workers wanting to make the most of a short vacation, Mactan is the safest choice given its low travel burden. Resting at the resort, then adding a day of hopping and a day of downtown Cebu sightseeing or a southern tour, makes for a well-balanced itinerary.
Mactan is connected to Cebu's main island by three bridges. The oldest, the Mactan–Mandaue Bridge, is a
truss bridge built in
; the cable-stayed Marcelo Fernan Bridge opened in
August 1999
, and the roughly
8.9km
Cebu–Cordova Link Expressway (CCLEX) opened in
April 2022
. The airport is divided into Terminal 1 (domestic), which opened in
, and Terminal 2 (international), which opened in
July 2018
, and a ceremony marking the completion of a second runway
long was held in
January 2025
. About 11.6 million passengers used the airport in 2025.

A full-day tour by bangka that takes in snorkeling with tropical fish at the Hilutungan marine sanctuary, the floating deck at Nalusuan, and the fishing village on Cauhagan. Many packages include a seafood barbecue lunch eaten aboard the boat, and tours usually leave around
and return around
. Routes that go on to the white sandbar at Pandanon Island (part of Bohol province) add about
1 hour
each way, and a fuel surcharge is often added.

blocks.title: Snorkeling and diving right off the resort

children.text: Mactan's east coast is close to a coral wall where the depth drops off sharply, allowing both shore diving and boat diving. There are many dive shops with Korean-speaking staff offering beginner trial dives and Open Water certification courses.

blocks.title: Mactan Shrine and the Lapu-Lapu statue

children.text: A historical park with the Lapu-Lapu statue, the Magellan Marker, and murals depicting the Battle of Mactan. It's a good idea to pair it with sutukil (seafood dishes) at the nearby seaside restaurant row.
At a Cebuano-style seafood restaurant — named for sugba (grilled), tuwa (soup), and kilawin (cured) — pick your fish, shrimp, and crab and have it cooked however you like.

Mactan has long been famous for handmade guitars, and you can see ukuleles and guitars crafted from woods like jackfruit, mahogany, and narra made right at the workshops. Small ukuleles are a popular souvenir.
If you're staying in the city or at a budget hotel, a large resort's day-use package lets you use its pool and beach for a day. Book ahead for weekends and holidays.
The wildlife sanctuary on Olango Island, off Mactan, is a Ramsar-designated migratory bird site. You can observe migratory birds around
September–March
, making it a good quiet half-day trip.
A nighttime attraction on the Day-as coast of Cordova, in southwestern Mactan, where 10,000 white roses with tiny built-in LEDs light up from around dusk. Admission is about
and parking about
, and the café is open
. It's best to arrive for the sunset and stay for the lights, which are on from

Marigondon Cave is an advanced dive with a maximum depth of about
and an entrance inhabited by flashlight fish, so it requires experience. Shore diving is also possible at the house reef in front of the resort.
Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB) is right on the island. Direct flights from Incheon, Busan, and other cities take about
4 hours 30 minutes
, and from Manila about
1 hour 20 minutes
, with dozens of domestic flights daily. From the airport to the east coast resorts by taxi or Grab takes about
20–40 minutes
, with fares around
. Most resorts offer paid pickup service, and pickups arranged through Korean travel agencies are also common.
From Cebu City you can cross to Mactan via the old Mactan-Mandaue Bridge, the Marcelo Fernan Bridge, or the Cebu-Cordova Link Expressway (CCLEX), which opened in
. By taxi or Grab it's about
40 minutes–1 hour 30 minutes
, around
, with heavy congestion during rush hour. CCLEX has a toll and is convenient for crossing directly from Cebu City's south coast (SRP) to Cordova in southern Mactan.
The CCLEX toll is about

for a car, and it is added to the fare if you cross by taxi or Grab. If you have little luggage, you can take MyBus, an air-conditioned airport bus that departs from in front of the airport, to SM City Cebu for about
, which takes about
1 hour
depending on traffic.
On the island, use taxis, Grab, tricycles, or multicabs (small jeepneys). Grab is the most convenient between the resort belt and the airport, and short distances by tricycle cost around
. Hopping tours depart from resort jetties or bangka jetties on Mactan's east coast, and agency tours often include hotel pickup.

If you're hiring a bangka independently, Maribago Wharf is the most common departure point, and boats also leave from Marigondon Wharf and the wharves on the Cordova side. Charter fares often exclude the island entrance fee and lunch, and the entrance fee, about
per person depending on the island, is paid separately in cash on the spot.
From Incheon, Korean Air, Jeju Air, Jin Air, T'way Air, and others operate direct flights to Mactan-Cebu International Airport, with a flight time of about
4 hours 25 minutes–4 hours 50 minutes

. There are also direct flights from Busan. Airlines and the number of flights per day of the week change by season, so check before booking. Evening departures often arrive around midnight, so you'll go straight to rest near the airport or at your resort on the first night, and immigration lines can get long at busy times.
From Manila (NAIA), Philippine Airlines, Cebu Pacific, and Philippines AirAsia operate direct flights, about 27 a day, taking about
1 hour 20 minutes–1 hour 35 minutes
. Round-trip promo fares start from around
but rise sharply during holidays and peak season.

Mactan-Cebu International Airport is divided into Terminal 1 (domestic) and Terminal 2 (international), and there is no connecting passage inside the secure area between the two. When transferring from an international to a domestic flight, you must collect your baggage, move to the other terminal, and check in again, so allow a connection time of at least
3 hours
White metered taxis picked up outside the airport have a base fare of about
plus about
per km, while the airport's dedicated yellow taxis start at a base fare of about
. Grab fares are set in the app, so there's no haggling. The air-conditioned MyBus runs from in front of both terminals toward SM City Cebu between
at intervals of about
20–30 minutes
, for a fare of
Passenger ferries to Olango Island run from the Punta Engaño pier in Mactan and from Santa Rosa port, taking about
30 minutes
with a one-way fare of about
. They run from early morning until around 8 PM but are cancelled in bad weather, and the wildlife sanctuary entrance fee (about
for foreigners) is paid separately on the spot.
The dry season from
December
to
May
is best.
January–April
has calm seas and good visibility, ideal for hopping and diving, and this overlaps with Korean winter break and Lunar New Year, so Korean visitor numbers peak.
March–May
is the hottest with strong sun, so sun protection is needed.
From
June
to
November
is the rainy season, with frequent afternoon showers, though days of all-day rain aren't that common. During typhoon season (mainly
August–November
), the Coast Guard may suspend small-boat operations, canceling hopping tours. Around
April 27
, the 'Kadaugan sa Mactan' event reenacting the Battle of Mactan is held, and the third week of
January
brings Cebu City's Sinulog Festival.
Kadaugan sa Mactan on
April 27
is an event reenacting the Battle of Mactan at Mactan Shrine (Liberty Shrine). The
event was the 505th, with the reenactment held at
. Times and holiday designations vary each year, so check announcements from Lapu-Lapu City. Also be aware of the region's disaster history. In
December 2021
, Typhoon Rai (local name Odette) struck the Mactan resorts and caused heavy damage, though most have since been repaired and reopened. In
, a magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck off Bogo in northern Cebu on
September 30
, and in early
November
Typhoon Kalmaegi (local name Tino) caused major damage in Cebu. Before departure, check the latest announcements on flight, hopping, and accommodation operations.

Mactan accommodation falls into three categories: large east-coast resorts, business hotels near the airport, and small to mid-sized resorts around Maribago and Punta Engaño. Large resorts with private beaches and waterpark-scale pools run about
or more a night, small to mid-sized resorts about
, and airport-area hotels about
. If you're traveling with kids, choose a resort with a pool and kids' club; if snorkeling is your goal, pick one with a good house reef.

Sutukil seafood is the signature food here. At restaurant rows near Mactan Shrine and along the coast, you pick seafood by weight from a tank and have it cooked to order, so check the price per kilo in advance. Cebu lechon, sweet Cebu mangoes, sinigang (a sour soup), and kilawin are also must-try dishes. Around Mactan Marina Mall and Island Central Mall there are Korean restaurants and grocery stores, so long-term stayers have little trouble.

By area, Punta Engaño at the northeastern tip is a quiet district with large luxury resorts and Mactan Shrine, while the Maribago–Marigondon area has small to mid-sized resorts, dive shops, massage shops, and restaurants clustered together, making it good for getting around on foot. Mactan Newtown, east of the airport, is a new town of high-rise condos and shopping malls, and a beach pass there costs about
(food and drink credit included). Massage starts at about
per hour at neighborhood spas and runs

or more per hour at resort and upscale spas. Sutukil restaurants cluster along the Punta Engaño roadside in front of Mactan Shrine, making them a good stop after visiting the shrine. For seafood, settle on the weight and cooking method, confirm the total, and then order.
The earlier a hopping tour departs, the calmer the sea and the fewer the crowds. Be sure to check whether per-island entrance fees are included in the tour price.
Feeding bread or crackers to fish at snorkeling spots during hopping tours violates marine sanctuary rules and harms the coral ecosystem.
Using Grab on arrival at the airport means no fare haggling. Check for the designated Grab pickup area on the arrivals floor.
Exchange rates at official money changers inside shopping malls are generally better than at the airport. For large amounts, it's safer to split the exchange across several locations.
Meals and drinks inside the resort are pricey, so eating one or two meals outside can significantly cut your budget.
At a sutukil restaurant, always check the per-kilo seafood price and the cooking fee before ordering.
Popular photo spots include Nalusuan Island's floating deck, Pandanon Island's sandbar, and in front of the Lapu-Lapu statue at Mactan Shrine.
To enter the Philippines you must register for eTravel, the free online arrival declaration, within
72 hours
before arrival. Taking a screenshot of the QR code you receive after registering speeds up airport immigration (
official eTravel site
). Beware of paid agency sites with similar names.
Mactan Shrine has no admission fee. Opening hours vary by source and are generally reported as morning to evening, so visit during the day. The Lapu-Lapu statue is a bronze statue erected in
, about
6m
tall, and the Magellan Marker is a stone obelisk erected in

Flights and resorts fill up early during Cebu City's Sinulog Festival on the third Sunday of January, the April Kadaugan period, Korea's Lunar New Year holiday, and the summer vacation, so book as early as possible.
Touting for hopping tours is common. Book through a registered operator or your accommodation, and check whether life vests are provided.
Wear aqua shoes while snorkeling to avoid cuts from sea urchins and coral, and don't step on or touch the coral.
There are seasons when jellyfish appear, so wear a rash guard, and if stung, rinse with vinegar and go to the resort's clinic.
Midday UV is very strong and can burn skin even in a short time. Prepare reef-safe sunscreen and a hat.
Some taxis around the airport and in front of malls charge excessive fares, so demand meter use or use Grab.
Adding Pandanon Island or the Bohol direction to a hopping route adds about
1 hour
each way, plus fuel costs. When chartering a boat independently, put the number of islands, the time, and whether fuel and entrance fees are included in a message so you have it in writing.
When a typhoon or strong wind warning is issued, the Coast Guard bans small bangka operations. Schedule your hopping tour on a day with flexibility in your itinerary.
